title: Water Damage Mitigation Training Note: HEPA Vacuuming Covered on the Stripped Floor
content:
**Training note — Water Damage Mitigation insurance coverage of HEPA vacuuming**

HEPA vacuuming is covered on the stripped floor: on a Category 2 job carrying HEPA vacuuming lines the square feet on those lines above the square feet on the job's pad removal lines, and on a Category 3 job carrying HEPA vacuuming lines the square feet on those lines above the sum of the pad removal square feet and 4 square feet for each linear foot on the flood cut lines, priced at the tier's HEPA vacuuming rate per square foot, are a non-covered amount; in any other case the HEPA vacuuming is covered.

## Questions answered
**What is the covered area on a Category 3 job?** The pad removal square feet and 4 square feet for every linear foot of flood cut, taken together; only the HEPA square feet above that total are non-covered.

**And on a Category 2 job?** The pad removal square feet alone.

**A Category 1 job?** The HEPA vacuuming is covered.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: HEPA vacuuming lines of 1100 square feet, pad removal 600 square feet, flood cut 80 linear feet, assumed rate $0.40)
| Water category | Square feet above the covered area | Non-covered amount |
|---|---|---|
| Category 2 | 500 | $200.00 |
| Category 3 | 1100 less the total of 600 and 320, that is 180 | $72.00 |
| Category 1 | none | none |
